# WeMind

> WeMind turns a personal WeChat account into an I/O channel for AI agents. It ships two mutually exclusive forms: an MCP server (`@wemind/wechat-mcp`) that any MCP client can drive, and a daemon (`wemind`) that long-polls WeChat itself, calls a resident ACP agent as its "brain", and replies automatically. Same bot token = one consumer only.

## Start here (AI agents)

## Code map

- `packages/wechat-ilink-core/`: iLink HTTP client, types, errors, session guard, account/state, image crypto. Private.
- `packages/wechat-mcp/`: MCP server with 6 tools. Published as `@wemind/wechat-mcp`.
- `packages/wechat-daemon/`: daemon, ACP brain, worker, CLI. Unpublished (`wemind`).
- `packages/wechat-daemon/src/brain-agents.ts`: `ACP_AGENT_PRESETS`, `resolveAgent()`, `agentProblem()`.
- `packages/wechat-daemon/src/acp-brain.ts`: resident ACP client (brain).
- `packages/wechat-daemon/src/worker-acp.ts`: resident ACP client (worker).
- `packages/wechat-daemon/src/mcp-sandbox.ts`: brain sandbox + MCP activation.
- `packages/wechat-daemon/src/index.ts`: message routing, turn orchestration, progress budget.

## Commands

- `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run lint`.
- `node packages/wechat-daemon/dist/cli.js list`
- `node packages/wechat-daemon/dist/cli.js brain <key>`
- `node packages/wechat-daemon/dist/cli.js brain check <key>`
- `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/doctor.ps1`
- `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/check-docs.ps1`
- `node scripts/acp-probe.mjs` (env: `ACP_BIN`, `ACP_ARGS`, `ACP_SHELL`, `ACP_HOME_ENV`, `ACP_HOME`, `ACP_MODEL`)

## Hard facts (2026-10-24)

- Default brain selection is `auto`: `kiro → opencode → gemini`; persisted in `<data>/brain.json`.
- `session/load` is not universal. DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 returns `-32601`; it has `session/resume` instead.
- DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 advertises `promptCapabilities.image:false`; image prompts fail with `-32602`.
- The repo has no `Brain` interface; `acp-brain.ts` exports `askBrain`/`newSession`/`restart`.
- iLink consecutive send limit is ~10; progress messages consume it.
- Windows `.cmd`/`.bat` agents must be launched through a shell; `binWin` must match the real filename (e.g. `dsh.cmd`).
